scene_1.texte: Time has passed, and chaos has ultimately forged new alliances.

scene_2.texte: Against all odds, the storm between Lilith and Esh has settled. Resentment has given way to a strange sisterhood of survivors.

scene_3.texte: To seal the cohesion of the summits, Lilith bound her destiny to Kelerm's. She is doing much better today, cured of her exhaustion.

scene_4.texte: But the outside world continues to impose its absurd cruelty. Tragedy struck the pack where no one expected it.

scene_5.texte: Little Thunder, one of the troop's ponies, passed away on the road, taken by a brutal and inexplicable starvation.

scene_6.texte: The irony was absolute: the wagons were overflowing with supplies. A simple oversight in logistics, and a life was gone.

scene_7.texte: This lapse in vigilance was quickly exploited. Taking advantage of Kuro's heavy sleep, the outlaw Raxx escaped.

scene_8.texte: This escape plunged Ash into a dark rage. Having become tyrannical and suspicious, the lieutenant swore he wouldn't be caught off guard again.

scene_9.texte: Kuro's sentence was immediate: sent to toil at the Garnet Equinox tavern to discreetly rob wealthy clients.

scene_10.texte: To fill the gaps, new faces were recruited. Among them was Zek, a mature crossbowman with a taciturn temperament.

scene_11.texte: A fisherman used to the calm of the waterlines, he found himself thrown into the heat of battle, instantly becoming our sniper.

scene_12.texte: Zek was quickly promoted to tavern supervisor. But with kindness, he established himself as a protective shadow for Kuro behind the scenes.

scene_13.texte: The other recruit, Akane, became the true ray of sunshine of the troop. Holding high her title of Scarlet Soul.

scene_14.texte: Her kindness broke the shells of the most hardened, and even the pack's predators come looking for her affection at the camp.

scene_15.texte: It is in this atmosphere that, chained in the center of the camp, the captured saboteur Lyss makes her entrance under Ash's icy gaze.

scene_16.texte: Around the fire, under the glowing red light, the Adepts await the moment when Lyss will agree to have her chains broken to survive by their side.
